story.iWant: a robust safety layer (Rollback, Automated Testing, Observability)
story.soThat: Jarvis cannot brick itself when it starts modifying its own code or configuration
story.tasks: - [ ] Task 1: Implement Safe Mode (AC: 1) - [ ] Task 2: Implement Rollback (AC: 2) - [ ] Task 3: Setup Pytest (AC: 3) - [ ] Task 4: Implement Health Dashboard (AC: 4)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Safe Mode Boot: `jarvis start --safe` loads minimal config (no agents, read-only memory). 2. Rollback Mechanism: `jarvis snapshot create/restore ` and auto-rollback on failure. 3. Pytest Integration: `tests/integration/` suite covering memory, retrieval, and planning. 4. Observability Dashboard: `/admin/health` endpoint returning Vector Index Health, Planner Stats, System Uptime.

doc.title: Epic 8 Planning
doc.snippet: Goal: The "Immune System" for Epic 8. Deliverables: Safe Mode, Rollback, Pytest Suite, Admin Dashboard.

item.reason: Entry point for Safe Mode implementation.

story-context.constraints: - Rollback must be atomic. - Safe Mode must not depend on external services (except DB).

tests.ideas: Simulate a crash and verify auto-rollback.
